initial_plan.can_answer: partly — crash data can show annual counts of motorists killed, but without vehicle miles driven it cannot establish a per-mile risk trend.
initial_plan.metric: Total motorists killed in police-reported NYC crashes per calendar year.
initial_plan.population: NYC police-reported crash records dated 2013–2025; treatment of missing motorist-death counts will be decided after the data check.

data_check.cohort: 2,132,218 crash rows dated 2013–2025; per-year counts and date spans are in check_1.csv.
data_check.missing_and_date_quality: crash_date and number_of_motorist_killed are missing on 0 of the 2,132,218 selected rows. crash_date is a typed DATE, and the selected cohort spans every calendar day from January 1 through December 31 in each year, 2013–2025. No in-range default date can be distinguished from a true crash date; numeric outcome values were not counted, so zero pileups or impossible numeric values were not assessed.
data_check.decision: Keep the full date-filtered cohort and disclose that no outcome-count rows are missing; no rows are dropped for missingness. No year is partial by observed date span.

final_plan.can_answer: partly — this dataset cannot measure motorists killed per mile driven because it has no vehicle-miles-traveled denominator; it can describe annual police-reported motorist-death counts.
final_plan.metric: Annual total of number_of_motorist_killed across NYC police-reported crashes.
final_plan.denominator: None; count of motorists recorded killed.
final_plan.population: Motorists counted by number_of_motorist_killed across all NYC police-reported motor vehicle crashes dated 2013–2025.
final_plan.filters: crash_date from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; retain all rows, with number_of_motorist_killed summed where nonmissing.
final_plan.years: Calendar years 2013–2025 inclusive; every year has crash-date rows on all calendar dates.
final_plan.limitations: This is a count of recorded motorist deaths, not a per-mile risk or rate; the data contains no miles-driven denominator. The data check found 0 missing crash dates or motorist-death counts among 2,132,218 selected crashes and no partial calendar years by observed date span; zero/default pileups and impossible numeric outcomes were not assessed in the data check.
